verdict.rationale: ClickUp's built-in Brain² is documented as reading your tasks, docs, and conversations and returning answers and insights inside the product, so the insights part of the story is directly supported. The evidence is only short marketing copy, and proactive suggestions are never explicitly documented, so full coverage is not established. External ChatGPT and MCP access are not in-product and are not credited. missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations, in-depth first-party docs on how insights are generated and shown, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Brain² taps Google Drive, GitHub, Salesforce, and more to get you answers and insights.
Brain² checks your workspace, apps, and the web for answers.
Brain² sees your tasks, docs, and conversations.
